verdict.rationale: Bun documents automatic lockfile migration: running `bun install` in a project without `bun.lock` converts an existing yarn.lock (v1), package-lock.json (lockfileVersion 2-4) or pnpm-lock.yaml. It also works in any existing package.json project and honors npm `overrides` and Yarn `resolutions`, so switching is mostly a single command. Migration caveats are documented: dependency lifecycle scripts are not run unless the package is listed in `trustedDependencies`, and one community report of install crashes only vaguely points to old lockfiles. missing for 10: Yarn Berry (v2+) lockfile migration, documented conversion of pnpm workspace config, independent hands-on confirmation that the lockfile migration works.
